verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own Approvals feature: admins turn approvals on, choose who approves, and review requests in Settings → Approvals, so a configurable approval gate exists. The evidence does not say which objects are gated, and it does not show approvals blocking jobs from going live or offers from being sent. missing for 10: explicit coverage of job openings and offers as approval subjects, multi-step/sequential approval chains, evidence that approval blocks publishing or sending, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, job openings and offers route through configurable approval chains before anything goes live or gets sent

citations.quote: Turn them on, choose who approves, and review requests in **Settings → Approvals**.
